verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication tool (to-dos, message boards, chat, card tables), not a code-hosting or code-review product, so AI breakdown of code diffs falls outside its category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships diff analysis. Its MCP and AI-agent support only lets agents work with Basecamp data; it says nothing about explaining code changes.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
